scope: Focused native/Editor integration QA of the actual E01 prefab, automatic ride states and actual asynchronous Tutorial-to-Gallery scene handoff. Review setup jumps to the existing final tutorial approach; actual CharacterController.Move enters the cabin, then a real kinematic rigidbody placed in the production safety bounds exercises reopening. Gallery.Tick drives the actual destination motor through the open doorway. Explicit -validation-no-capture disables validation Camera.Render, pixel reads and PNG output. Three graphics assertions are reported as skipped and are not counted as passed; physics, audio and real scene handoffs still run. This is not a continuous tutorial puzzle playthrough or subjective art/audio approval.
